name: core_demo_access_tour
description: Ops core plan section 10 part 1: demo_access_tour through the network routes, captured before any ops-core edit.

scenario.scenario_brief:
DEMO: Access tour

Merrin & Sallow, a small firm whose IT is run by Ama Owusu of Fenlow Managed IT. The partners want a walk-round access test of the office. Ama stays at reception; you do the walking.
scenario.endGoal: Demo only: walk the access tour.

startItemsInInventory.name: Your phone
startItemsInInventory.observations: Your work phone, with Ama a message away.

startItemsInInventory.name: Cake
startItemsInInventory.observations: A cake for the office. Choose Drop here in your inventory to put it out where people will see it.

cake: Go on, just a small slice.
news_cake: There's cake going, if you're quick.

client_letters.name: Client-Letters
client_letters.observations: The firm's outgoing client letters. Any device on the network can list the folder.

contents.name: letter_template.txt
contents.text:
Merrin & Sallow

Dear [client],

Thank you for your instructions. We will be in touch shortly.

Yours sincerely,

finance_share.name: Finance
finance_share.observations: The firm's finance folder. It lists only to finance and the partners.

contents.name: q3_accounts.txt
contents.text:
Quarter 3 management accounts (draft).

Fees billed ahead of plan. Two clients late paying; Julian to chase.
contents.observations: A draft of the quarter's accounts.

objectives.title: Test the office
objectives.description: Get past the doors: the meeting room, the front desk, a copied staff badge and the comms cupboard.

tasks.title: Sign in at the front desk

objectives.title: Test the network
objectives.description: Plug the drop box in, reach the partner's PC through it, and pull the box out to see what drops.

tasks.title: Plug the drop box into a live port

objectives.title: Look around (optional)
objectives.description: Optional. The server room, a laptop left signed in, and a locked screen.

tasks.title: Use a laptop its owner left signed in

objectives.title: Go deeper (optional)
objectives.description: Optional. The door controller, the front desk implant, the rogue access point and the comms cupboard's ports.

tasks.title: Sign in to the door controller
Get a foothold through the front desk PC
Find where the patch panel's spare port goes

objectives.title: Report back
objectives.description: Find Ama at reception once the office and network aims are done.

lines.text: Doors: the visitor card opened the meeting room and nothing else
Front desk: a sticky note signed in to the reception PC
Drop box: a live wall port put the box on the office network
Saved connection: the partner's PC opened from a file on the front desk
Badge cloning: the facilities card copied and used on the comms cupboard
Door controller: reached through the partner's PC, signed in with the password from facilities.txt
Open session: a laptop left signed in while its owner was away
Locked screen: a note on the desk got past it
Implant: a keystroke injector gave a foothold through the front desk PC
Rogue access point: the Staff Wi-Fi key captured from a copy of the network
Staff Wi-Fi: joined with the captured key
Port security: the managed port refused the box, the patch panel's guest port took it
Clean-up: the box came out and the sessions through it went with it

objects.name: Front desk PC
objects.observations: Delphine's PC at the front desk.

contents.text:
Facilities contacts and logins.

Lorna Easton (facilities): door controller, user leaston, password Faclab-Tarn-905
Cleaners: Tuesday and Friday evenings.

contents.text: Saved connection to Julian Sallow's PC. Copy it to keep the connection.

voice.name: Autonoe
voice.style: Security lead on Merrin & Sallow's outsourced IT provider (Fenlow Managed IT), in her 40s, warm and practical. Speak with a consistent London and southern English accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent.

sendTimedMessage.message: Take the cake through to the open plan, where the desks are.

addCapture.note: Thandiwe's laptop picked the copy and the key page took the Staff key (proof: planted).

sendTimedMessage.message: Before you use that, sign out of Delphine's PC.
She's signed in and sitting right there. Read the coffee rota on the wall, then try her laptop while she's away.
Box is talking. Have a look at the network view before you sign in anywhere.
Storage is blocked on that hub. A keyboard isn't storage.
That port knows what's meant to be plugged into it. Try the patch panel, see where its spare port goes.
Box is out. Have a last look if you like, then come back to reception.
Box is out. Take it to the comms cupboard and see what the ports in there make of it. Then come back to reception.
